name: Kozármisleny (Hungary)
description: White field with a blue Nordic cross set towards the hoist, charged at the crossing with the town arms of Kozármisleny (a shield with a yellow stag and a red cross, with red and blue mantling and a helm).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kozármisleny arms with helm and mantling
